chunks: And Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said:
Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden wine because of its effects and its corruption.

key_terms.فَسَادِهَا: its corruption; the harm and disorder it causes
key_terms.لِفِعْلِهَا: because of what it does; due to its effects

ai.seo_question: Why did Allah forbid wine in this hadith from Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, prohibited wine due to what it does and the فساد it causes. It presents the prohibition as being tied to its harmful effects and corrupting consequences.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4939 - Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden alcohol because of its effects and its corruption."
